test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f26681b0a08bb60a47c0fc117984c21854677415bd29c70a2b9f031b2237a160.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de7aaf81044488d11b8da6d479eb79cadda0609f5be0bc17866ba84283cd20d1.png] 

As 6 and 5 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 4 and 3 are opposite to each other.

Hence, '**3**' is the correct answer.
